description: Figure 3, titled "Domain distribution of our annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set (covering 12 domains in total)," is a pie chart that illustrates the proportion of the test set samples across different domains. The chart is divided into multiple slices, each representing a distinct domain. The largest slice, colored in a dark gray, represents the "AI/NLP Research" domain, which accounts for the majority of the samples. Other domains include "Science," "Technology," "Health," "Sports," "Entertainment," "Politics," "Business," "Education," "Geography," "History," and "Other," each represented by a different shade of gray or color. The sizes of the slices vary, indicating the relative number of samples in each domain, with "AI/NLP Research" being the most prominent. The chart provides a visual representation of the diversity and distribution of the test set across the 12 domains.
